## 

[Train-router repository](https://github.com/Flightmussy/trainrouter-atlas)

```{r}
# renv::install("tidyverse")
# renv::install("sf")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
routes_df <- read_csv(here("data/train_router/routes.csv"))

routes_df |>
    slice_min(fame_rank, n = 10) |>
    select(name, from, to, distance_km)
```

```{r}

gdf <- st_read(here("data/train_router/routes.geojson"))

ggplot(gdf) +
    geom_sf(aes(color = category)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
```
